fullDesc: On October 30, 1974 in Kinshasa, Zaire, 32-year-old Muhammad Ali beat undefeated heavyweight champion George Foreman. He leaned on the ropes and let Foreman tire before knocking him out in the eighth round.
realFacts: The fight was promoted by Don King
It was delayed by Foreman's cut
Ali won back the title he had been stripped of
It was the subject of the film When We Were Kings
